description:
# **CodeStorm 2026: FutureForge**

## **Build the Future. Shape the Impossible.**

CodeStorm 2026: FutureForge is a student-focused innovation hackathon where developers, designers, creators, and problem-solvers come together to build impactful solutions using technology.

Unlike traditional hackathons that focus on a single domain, FutureForge embraces **Open Innovation**, allowing participants to tackle real-world challenges across any field they are passionate about. Whether it's Artificial Intelligence, Web Development, Cybersecurity, Education Technology, Sustainability, Productivity Tools, Mobile Applications, or something entirely unique, this is your platform to innovate.

This hackathon is part of the **CodeStorm 2026 Series**, an initiative dedicated to empowering students through hands-on learning, collaboration, and innovation.

The event will be conducted completely online through our Discord community. Participation is free, and teams may consist of **1–6 members**.

Participants are encouraged to think boldly, experiment fearlessly, and build projects that create meaningful impact while showcasing technical excellence and creativity.

## **What Can You Build?**

Participants are encouraged to develop:

* Artificial Intelligence solutions
* Web applications and platforms
* Mobile applications
* Cybersecurity tools
* Productivity and automation software
* Educational technology solutions
* Sustainability and social impact projects
* Games and interactive experiences
* Open-source projects
* Any innovative idea that solves a real-world problem

## **Why Participate?**

* Build real-world projects
* Learn and apply emerging technologies
* Collaborate with talented students
* Showcase your skills to a wider audience
* Receive certificates and recognition
* Win exciting rewards and prizes
* Join a growing community of innovators

## **Guidelines**

* Follow the Code of Conduct.
* Team size: **1–6 members**.
* Projects must be developed during the hackathon period.
* Open-source libraries, frameworks, and APIs may be used.
* Submissions must include a working prototype, demo, or showcase.
* Participants must submit all required materials before the deadline.

## **Important Links**

### Join Our Official Discord Server

https://discord.com/invite/a3mE9SMCqb

### Follow Us On Instagram

https://www.instagram.com/code_storm_hackathon/

### Official Website

https://code-storm-hackathon.pages.dev

## **Community**

CodeStorm is a student-led initiative dedicated to creating opportunities for young innovators, builders, and creators across India.

### **Team CodeStorm ⚡**

**Empowering India's Next Generation of Innovators**

# Join Our Discord Server For Official Announcements, Results, Winner Updates, and Certificate Distribution

https://discord.com/invite/a3mE9SMCqb

hackathon_faqs.answer: **Individuals with a passion for technology, coding, design, or innovation are encouraged to participate. Whether you are a student, beginner, or an experienced developer, all are welcome.**
hackathon_faqs.question: Who can participate in CodeStorm 2026?

hackathon_faqs.answer: **You can build web apps, AI tools, games, automation projects, productivity tools, or any creative tech solution related to the weekly track.**
hackathon_faqs.question: What kind of projects can we build?

hackathon_faqs.answer: **No. CodeStorm 2026 is completely free to participate in.**
hackathon_faqs.question: Is there any registration fee?

hackathon_faqs.answer: **Yes. You can participate individually or with a team of up to 6 members.**
hackathon_faqs.question: Can I participate solo?

hackathon_faqs.answer: **Only the winning participants will receive a digital certificate of excellence. And other will receive participation certificate **
hackathon_faqs.question: Will all participants receive certificates?

hackathon_faqs.answer: **All updates, announcements, and communication will happen through the official Discord server.**
hackathon_faqs.question: Where will announcements and updates be shared?
